calibration.overflow: triangles at clipped chart boundary with unrounded value in tooltip and table
calibration.lod2: 20 cm; current case: roof type and wall; pooled: site roof/wall, optional site roof type/wall

population.scope: eval by default; obey sidebar filters; only finite uncertainty and actual error
population.exclusion_applies: prior only, charts only; off by default
population.exclusion_warning: 참값으로 뺀 것. 불확실도가 4τ에 가까운 구간은 실제 오차가 작게 나올 수 있음.

sparsification.uncertainty_order: descending uncertainty, ascending patch index, then site order
sparsification.ideal_order: descending actual error, ascending patch index, then site order
sparsification.normalized: remaining error mean / initial error mean; zero baseline unavailable
sparsification.lod2: unavailable: constant uncertainty has no ordering

faces.lod2: exact regions_ext_v3 surf_ext, cross-check patch surf and centre
faces.als_roof: XY triangle containment including boundary 1e-9; nearest interpolated Z; tie surface ext ascending
faces.als_wall: minimum Euclidean point-to-triangle distance <= 1 m; tie surface ext ascending
faces.fallback: floor(local x/2), floor(local y/2); 2 m XY grid; Z median for display
faces.aggregation: current scope and sidebar/map drill-down filters; continuous finite median; missed area fraction; categories count majority and share
faces.roof_type: LoD2 building attribute; ALS face view inherits matched LoD2 attribute; patch source unchanged
faces.verification: 10 LoD2 faces per case; numpy default_rng(seed + case index); independent source patch medians

pair_statistics: LoD2 faces only, both medians finite and both sufficiently sampled; Spearman and median(right/left); constant rank unavailable; grids excluded
